content: Yɛsu kan'kɔɔr ikar mwɛy wàbaal
Ungö a indiir abi byanswà, kàkäl anà un'kyɔm a Ayudà, waa Yɛsu kàbeenà Yɛlusàlɛm.
Kyekà, u Yɛlusàlɛm, tsütsü a munàmbwo a In'kɔk, kyàkäl anà itɛy a an'dà bàfàbel un'sà Ɛbɛlyɔ naa Bɛtesdà. Kya kyàkäl anà myäy, myäy in'tyeen.
Ungyɛl a myäy ami un'kàbɔ abɛy bàkäl musil: ikwàmii, aŋibweel anà ikar bàkäl mudil naa an'dà inini,
ntɔn utaaŋ làmwɛy un'kyeey a Mwol mwɛy kàfatɔlà uboo a itɛy, waa kàfanii an'dà. Un'bɛy atàtwɛb kàfatɔlà kan'dà aŋàni, kàkyer afakɔɔrà itàkal naa ukyal ande abɛy bàkaben.
Kwo kàkäl anà ikar mwɛy kàkäl anà ukyal mbul an'kwem an'tär aŋinaan.
Utaaŋ kun'mɛn Yɛsu wàŋàbɔ̈ɔ̈n anà kàyöb nde naa nde kàbɛl itaan, nde kun'fuul naa: « Nkye ngye akyàkwen akɔɔrà? »
Ikar kun'fuur naa: « Mwol, mɛ in'we anki anà mbuur akan'tɔɔm uboo a itɛy umpal ifàsɛmà an'dà munini. Umpal in'kyà mɛ, mbuur asin kan'tɔɔmà kusà a mɛ. »
Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: « Mbarà, sɛn ipɔy angye, kyen. »
Apan sye, baal awà waa kàkɔɔrà, kàsɛn ipɔy ande, waa kàsɛmà mukyà. Kyekà, ilä akin kyàkäl ilä a saba.
Apan, amfum a Ayudà bàfuul baal awà kàkɔɔrà naa: « Ŋàbà ilä a saba, ngye mbwo musyen ipɔy angye yatɛy. »
Wɛɛ nde kafuur naa: « Mbuur awà kan'kɔɔr, atɛn a mɛ naa: "Wal ipɔy angye, kyen." »
Ba bun'fuul naa: « Nà mbuur awà atɛn a ngye naa: "Wal ipɔy angye, kyen"? »
Wɛɛ mbuur awà kàkɔɔrà, kàyöbà anki naa nà kun'kɔɔr, ntɔn Yɛsu kàbilà uboo a iköŋ a baar bàkäl kà ikal akin.
Ungöngö, Yɛsu kàfun'man uboo a ndwà a Nzam, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Le, apanà ngye awà ŋàkɔɔrà. Twon an'fàkyer man'be, ntɔn undiir aŋàsöön ube ukɔɔn afayeel. »
Baal awà kàkàkyään amfum a Ayudà naa Yɛsu kun'kɔɔr.
Lalan Ayudà bàmɛɛyà ba Yɛsu nkwaaŋ, ntɔn nde indiir abi kàkyerà ilä a saba.
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kafuur naa: « Tii lalà Taa wàmusal, mɛ sye in'wàmusal. »
Ntɔn ndaa ayi, amfum a Ayudà bàyileŋà ipöl mbɔɔn mukun'dwa, kànà ntɔn kàbɛyà nde saba anki, wɛɛ ntɔn kàtɛɛnà nde naa Nzam wà Taarànde ŋakwo, abà nde mumɛnà làsii làmwɛy anà Nzam.
Ikɔ̈b a Mwan a Nzam

Apan Yɛsu kàfàwal ndaa, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Ndandaa, ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, Mwan ukwe anki mukyer akà undiir mwɛy nde ŋakwo, wɛɛ nà wa akwà ufàman nde mukyer akà Taa. Ntɔn indiir byanswà ufàkyer Taa, Mwan sye afàkyer bya.
Ntɔn Taa akwen Mwan, anà nde sye afun'swaŋ indiir byanswà ufàkyer nde ŋakwo. Nde afàsun'swaŋ indiir mwɛy byàkölàköl byan'söön abi ntɔn bɛ làsàkal unsà ubem.
Ntɔn, asànaa Taa ufàwiy nde akü anà ufapà nde mɔ̈ɔ̈, abun sye Mwan afàpà mɔ̈ɔ̈ akà mbuur awukwen nde.
Taa ufàtsüül anki mbuur nsaŋ, wɛɛ nde ikɔ̈b atsul nsaŋ kyanswà kàpɛ akà Mwan,
ntɔn baar banswà bàsi Mwan làkoo asànaa bàfàsà ba Taa làkoo. Mbuur mpa afàsà Mwan làkoo, nde sye Taa awà kun'töm ufun'sà anki làkoo. »

Nde kàkwɛy naa: « Ndandaa, ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, mbuur wanswà afàwem ndaa amɛ anà afàsà làkwikilà amu mbuur kan'töm, nde we anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye, nde uyà anki u nsaŋ, wɛɛ nde kàkyàtoo itaan unsà ukwà, nde kàkyàwal mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Ndandaa, ndandaa mɛ alakyään, taaŋ làmuyà - la sye lan'kwo - alà bàsàwem akü ndaa a Mwan a Nzam. Baar bàsàwem ya, bàsàkal anà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Ntɔn, asànaa Taa awà nde anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ amu nde ŋakwo, nde kàpɛ mbwo akà Mwan mukal anà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Nde kun'pɛ ikɔ̈b mutsul nsaŋ, ntɔn nde wà Mwan a mbuur.
Twon lan'man ndaa yubem unsà ya, ntɔn taaŋ làmuyà alà bàsàwem baar banswà abà uboo a an'dii ndaa ande.
Baar bàkyer indiir aŋàbwaŋ bàsàwiyà ntɔn muwal mɔ̈ɔ̈, wɛɛ baar bàkyer indiir ibe, ba bàsàwiyà ntɔn nsaŋ.

Mɛ, mɛ in'kwe anki mukyer akà undiir mwɛy mɛ ŋakwo: mɛ in'fàtsul nsaŋ a ndaa in'fàwem mɛ, lalan mbar in'fàtsul mɛ yà balàbal, ntɔn mɛ in'fàleŋ anki ukwen amɛ ŋakwo, wɛɛ mɛ in'fàleŋ ukwen a mbuur kan'töm.
Imbäl ntɔn Yɛsu
« Ilàkal naa mɛ kàtɛɛ imbäl ntɔn mɛ ŋakwo, kya kyàlàkal anki kyà ndandaa.
Wɛɛ mbuur asin afan'tɛɛl imbäl anà mɛ sye in'kyàyöb naa imbäl ufan'tɛɛl nde kyà ndandaa.
Bɛ, bɛ làtöm akyeey akà Ywan, nde waa kàtɛɛl ndandaa imbäl.
Akà mɛ, mɛ mfun a imbäl a mbuur kyatɛy, wɛɛ an'tɛn mɛ abà, ntɔn bɛ làwü mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Ywan kàkäl asànaa mwinà aŋàkyää wàmupà pɛɛlà: u taaŋ làmwɛy bɛ làkwen muman un'sak a pɛɛlà ande.
Wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ in'we anà imbäl aŋàsöön kyà Ywan, ntɔn isal abyà kan'pɛ Taa mukyer, isal nsil bya in'fàkyer mɛ bi anà bya ifan'tɛɛl imbäl ntɔn muswaŋ naa Taa kan'töm.
Taa awà kan'töm nde ŋakwo kàtɛ imbäl ntɔn mɛ. Wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ làwem anki akà ikikye ndaa ande, bɛ làmɛn anki akà ikikye ntabwey ande.
Ndaa ande yatɛy amu bɛ, ntɔn bɛ mbuur kun'töm làfun'sà anki làkwikilà.
Bɛ, bɛ làfàlab pànsi pànsi Ndaa Aŋàsɔn, ntɔn bɛ làfàsi naa bɛ làwal mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a intye uboo aya: kyekà ya ŋakwo ifàtà imbäl ntɔn mɛ!
Wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ làkwen anki muyà akà mɛ ntɔn muwal mɔ̈ɔ̈.
« Mɛ in'fàwal anki làkoo làfàfà akà baar.
Wɛɛ mɛ in'kyàyöb naa amu bɛ ukwen batɛy akà Nzam.
Mɛ, mɛ kàyi kà ikɔb a Taa, wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ làtön mukan'wal. Isàkal naa mbuur asin kan'yà kà ikɔb ande ŋakwo, bɛ làkyer asun'wal!
Aben, nkye bɛ lan'kwo mukal anà làkwikilà, bɛ baar làkoo abɛ làfàfà akà bɛ a bɛ, anà mpa làfàleŋ làkoo làfàfà akà Nzam mpɛl?
Bɛ twon lan'si naa mɛ in'sàkyer alafüün kusà a Taa. Mbuur afüünà bɛ Mɔsɛ awà làsi bɛ làkyän abɛ.
Kyakin, yàlàkal naa bɛ làsi làkwikilà amu Mɔsɛ, bɛ làlàsà làkwikilà akà mɛ sye, ntɔn nde kàsön ntɔn mɛ.
Wɛɛ isàkal naa bɛ làsi anki làkwikilà u ndaa kàsön nde, bɛ lan'kwo aben musà làkwikilà u ndaa amɛ? »
